== History & Background (Dossier) ==
The other Gas Giants (Agnau, Uvuegh, and Enegh) are all in eccentric orbits and have systematically reduced the outer system to rubble. Surviving worlds and moons are heavily cratered as a result{{Page cite|name=Deneb Sector|page=32|citeName=DS32}}. 

Agnau and Uvuegh passed within 5,000,000km of each other 300,000 years ago{{Page cite|name=Deneb Sector|page=32|citeName=DS32}}.

The Research Station's outer group studies the outer system's belts, rubble and oort clouds.

None of the bodies (other than [[Aerfor (world)|Aerfor]]) has an official population - that is not to say that the planets don't attract illegal transient prospectors or transient researchers, but they are not counted as residents.
